payload.posture: Read Genesis 43:15–25 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states benjamin’s presence changes Joseph’s instructions; the brothers explain the money while the steward speaks of peace and their God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Fear at Joseph’s house meets the steward’s reassurance
